title: Hundreds of Birds Share One 20-Foot Nest That Weighs a Ton

scenes.text: African birds build a single nest that weighs a ton.
Sociable weavers weave one shared nest in a tree, up to twenty feet across.
It can hold up to five hundred birds, each pair in its own chamber.
All that grass and sticks can weigh a ton or more.
The birds keep adding to it for decades, and some nests last over a hundred years.
A bird-built apartment block, a century old.

description:
Sociable weavers in Africa build giant shared nests up to 20 feet across that hold up to 500 birds.

Would you move in?
